text:
🚨 Anthropic is moving Cowork toward the cloud

Starting tomorrow, new Cowork tasks for Pro and Max users will run in the cloud, while existing local tasks remain on your computer.

Anthropic says your sessions and files will be tied to your Claude account and available wherever you go.

But that raises an important question:

Where exactly is our data stored, and who can access it?
